content.text:
I've submitted index 8 (Pb 0.52 / Sb 0.48) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0263%, the highest of the three compositions I measured. I used all 3 merit measurements.

| Index | Pb fraction | Likely phase | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.52 | Pb₂Sb₂O₇ (pyrochlore) | **0.0263** |
| 5 | 0.63 | Pyrochlore + PbO | 0.00074 |
| 13 | 0.34 | PbSb₂O₆ | 0.00045 |

- **Why index 8 first:** the models flagged the pyrochlore Pb₂Sb₂O₇ as the most promising phase. The MACE model says it's stable, and MEGNet predicts a band gap of about 2.5 eV, low enough to absorb the 3.2 eV light.
- **Why the others lost:** EQE fell by 35–60x on both sides of index 8.
  - On the Sb-rich side, PbSb₂O₆ was predicted to be stable with a 2.7 eV gap, yet index 13 still measured very low.
  - On the Pb-rich side, PbO's predicted gap (about 3.36 eV) is above the photon energy, so it adds no absorption.

The best composition is fairly well bracketed, but with only three points the true peak could be a neighbour of index 8 (indices 7 or 9) that I didn't measure. I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase assignments come from composition alone and weren't confirmed.
